1. Ability to Pay
(a) The gross rental costs plus utilities shall not exceed 25% of the family's gross income.
(b) Purchase prices shall not exceed 2-1/2 times the family's gross income.
2. Occupancy
Standards for occupancy shall conform to applicable local housing codes and similar ordinances or regulations which may be applicable to a specific property.
3. Physical Requirements
The minimum requirements for a decent, safe and sanitary dwelling shall be those which meet all of the provisions of the Standards for Decent, Safe and Sanitary Housing as enumerated in Chapter 48, Wisconsin Administrative Code, as adopted.
SERVICES
In addition to maintaining necessary records and performing various other administrative functions, the relocation staff will offer and provide the following assistance to all displacees:
1. Counsel each individual and family with regard to their specific rehousing needs resulting in each securing replacement housing that is decent, safe and sanitary; adequate for their needs; suitably located; and within their financial means.
